description_en: Submits a batch of log ingestion tasks
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem submit-import-log-tasks --prod-code qcloud_waf --log-codes cloud_siem_qcloud_cfw_alert_log --accounts AccountId_:_123123_,_Imported_:1 --auto-imported 1 --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitImportLogTasks

parameters.help_en: The list of logs to be ingested. The value must be a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 提交接入的日志列表，json数组格式
parameters.name: log_codes

parameters.help_en:
The list of accounts for log ingestion. The value must be a JSON array. Valid values:

- AccountId: The ID of the account.

- Imported: Specifies whether to enable or disable log ingestion for the account. Valid values:

  - 0: Disable ingestion.

  - 1: Enable ingestion
parameters.help_zh:
提交接入的账号列表，json数组格式。取值：
 - AccountId：待接入的账号ID。 
 - Imported：是否接入/取消接入该账号。取值：
   - 0：取消接入。 
   - 1：接入
parameters.name: accounts

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically enable log ingestion for accounts that are configured with the specified log. Valid values:

- 1: Yes.

- 0: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动接入配置了该日志的账号。取值：
 - 1：自动接入。 
 - 0：不自动接入
parameters.name: auto_imported

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service provider
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for Threat Analysis is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member that the administrator wants to access
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The type of view. Valid values:

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts within the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type
